Same markup as habits-corpus.json. Hand-written, no tester data. The fixes for its findings (you know + object, verb/degree repeats, "like basically done") were made against it, so it is a regression bar, not an untouched holdout. Unmarked words qa-critic left were marked by the classifier author, lowercase (not confident): so/r as an opener (as in the holdout), so/f in "and so like yeah", basically/r in "basically done" (degree).
